criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person (Political/Historical Figure)
categories.definition: An individual notable for their role in politics, government, or historical events.

categories.name: Person (Athlete)
categories.definition: An individual notable for their achievements in sports.

categories.name: Person (Artist/Writer/Musician)
categories.definition: An individual notable for their creative works in arts, literature, or music.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural landform, body of water, or a designated geographical area.

categories.name: Plant Species
categories.definition: A specific type of plant or a genus of plants.

categories.name: Populated Place
categories.definition: A human settlement such as a village, town, or city.

categories.name: Company/Organization
categories.definition: A business entity, institution, or group formed for a particular purpose.

categories.name: Book/Literary Work
categories.definition: A written work of fiction or non-fiction, including novels, short stories, and graphic novels.

categories.name: Film/TV Series
categories.definition: A motion picture, television program, or series.

categories.name: Music Album
categories.definition: A collection of musical recordings released together.

categories.name: Building/Structure
categories.definition: A permanent construction built for habitation, worship, industry, or other purposes.

categories.name: Vehicle (Land)
categories.definition: A machine used for transport on land, such as a car, train, or motorcycle.

categories.name: Vehicle (Water)
categories.definition: A machine used for transport on water, such as a ship, ferry, or submarine.

categories.name: Vehicle (Air)
categories.definition: A machine used for transport in the air, such as an aircraft.

categories.name: Animal Species
categories.definition: A specific type of animal or a genus of animals.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An organization dedicated to education, such as a school, college, or university.

categories.name: Publication (Periodical)
categories.definition: A publication issued at regular intervals, such as a journal, newspaper, or magazine.

categories.name: Product/Service
categories.definition: A commercial offering or utility provided to customers.
